check: The job requires 4 × 45 = 180 pug-minutes, so 15 pugs take 180/15 = 12 minutes. Their combined rate is 15/180 houses per minute, not 1/2700.
evidence_quote: So, the rate for 15 pugs is \( \frac{1 \text{ house}}{60 \times 45 \text{ minutes}} \).
error_description: The solution divides the single-pug rate by 15 instead of multiplying it by 15. It then treats a rate as a time and incorrectly converts it to hours, yielding 0.22 minutes.
